general.title: General information
general.processingType: Processing type: Topographic Adjustment. The BTM project is inherited from the current context.
general.name: Processing name

general.changePresetConfirm: Changing the template resets station, measurement, initial-coordinate, adjustment, execution and output proposals. Continue?
general.validityCreateHelp: Start of validity for version 1. This is an activation timestamp, not the observation window used to calculate initial coordinates.
general.validityEditHelp: Start of validity for the new configuration version. This is an activation timestamp, not the observation window used to calculate initial coordinates.

stations.title: Stations available in BTM
stations.networkHelp: Select at least two stations belonging to one connected network. Independent groups require separate processings.
stations.selectedSummary: {{stations}} selected · {{targets}} proposed for review in Targets & measurements

instruments.title: Instruments and atmospheric correction
instruments.help: This step contains station-level properties only. EDM mode, reflector, prism constant and target height are resolved for each station-to-target measurement in the next step.

atmosphereModes.already-applied: Already applied by the total station
atmosphereModes.cycle-temperature-pressure: BTM correction using T/P for each cycle

instruments.missingPolicy: If T/P is missing or invalid

missingPolicies.wait-or-fail: Wait or fail this output slot
missingPolicies.assume-already-corrected: Treat the distance as already corrected

instruments.cycleMapping: BTM raw_data mapping: temperature variable {{temperature}} · pressure variable {{pressure}}. Values are resolved for each station cycle.
instruments.cycleMissing: No compatible temperature/pressure variables are mapped for this station; the selected missing-data policy will apply.
instruments.formula: Formula: {{formula}} v{{version}} — ppm = 281.8 − 0.29065 × P / (1 + T/273.15); corrected slope distance = distance after reflector correction × (1 + ppm×10⁻⁶). This is not the STAR*NET .SCALE factor.
instruments.noFactor: No BTM atmospheric factor is applied in this mode.
instruments.required: Station required for a network adjustment

targets.title: Targets and measurement setups
targets.help: Review target identity, calculation usage and measurement corrections. BTM identifiers remain visible for traceability.
targets.searchPlaceholder: Target, station, STAR*NET ID, sensor, Hz/Vz/Sd…
targets.reflectorlessHelp: Reflectorless measurements do not use a prism constant.
targets.empty: No target matches the current filters.
targets.emptyHelp: Clear or broaden the search criteria.
targets.correctionHelp: BTM Δ = required prism constant − constant already applied to the stored slope distance. Constants are entered in millimetres and target heights in metres. Reflectorless measurements have no prism constant. Values come from BTM metadata, then the template, then explicit overrides.

commonPoints.title: Shared physical points (network)
commonPoints.help: Identify observations from different stations that refer to the same physical point. Start with two certain homologous pairs; add a third well-distributed pair whenever possible to obtain redundant geometry.
commonPoints.duplicate: A station target can be used only once among the seed pairs.
commonPoints.proposalHelp: The calculation only proposes geometrically compatible pairs within the tolerances. No physical identity is created until you select and confirm the proposals.
commonPoints.readyMessage: {{count}} geometrically compatible pair(s) found. Review them before confirming.
commonPoints.weakMessage: {{count}} pair(s) found, but two seed points provide no redundancy. Add a third well-spread common point if possible.
commonPoints.insufficientMessage: The seed pairs do not define a usable relative orientation.
commonPoints.confirmAria: Confirm {{a}} and {{b}} as the same physical point

initialisation.title: Initial coordinates
initialisation.localMode: No known coordinates — fix one station (recommended for a new local network)
initialisation.localZero: E/N/H/orientation = 0/0/0/0 is valid for an arbitrary local frame
initialisation.knownHelp: Only coordinates explicitly supplied with the dataset are proposed. Select the control points that belong to this network.
initialisation.invalidRange: Choose two existing cycles in chronological order.
initialisation.periodHelp: This window selects the observations used to calculate initial coordinates; it does not define their validity. For a network, the first station provides the reference cycle calendar and observations from every selected station are retained inside the UTC range.
initialisation.stationSolution: E {{easting}} m · N {{northing}} m · H {{height}} m · orientation {{orientation}}° ({{source}})

period.title: Observation window used for initialisation
period.calendarHelp: Dates and times are existing acquisition cycles of the reference station {{station}}.
period.empty: No acquisition cycle is available for the reference station.
period.invalidStart: The start value is not an existing {{station}} acquisition cycle. Select a listed time.
period.invalidEnd: The end value is not an existing {{station}} acquisition cycle. Select a listed time.
period.unordered: The start cycle must be before or equal to the end cycle.

adjustment.title: Adjustment configuration (STAR*NET)
adjustment.frWeightsWarning: The FR weights and centring errors are editable Topcon proposals, not a national standard. A surveyor must validate them before activation.
adjustment.acceptWeights: I have reviewed and accept these weights for this configuration version
adjustment.convergenceHelp: Threshold on the variation of the weighted sum of squares; it is not a coordinate tolerance.
adjustment.errorPropagation: Propagate the variance factor to coordinate uncertainties

chiPolicies.fail-run: Fail the run and do not publish
chiPolicies.publish-failed-qc: Publish with failed-QC status (only when explicitly authorised)

adjustment.geodesyHelp: .SCALE is a horizontal datum factor and the refraction coefficient applies to zenith geometry. Neither replaces the EDM temperature/pressure correction.
adjustment.testTitle: Test this adjustment on one epoch
adjustment.testHelp: First prepare and inspect the complete epoch with the scientific preview. You may then submit the exact generated .dat and native-template .prj to STAR*NET 14. Neither configuration test publishes results.
adjustment.noSlot: No output slot is available. Select at least one station with observations before testing the adjustment.
adjustment.realDescription: Connect to the temporary Windows service, run the prepared epoch and inspect the native STAR*NET outputs here.

run.title: Execution and epoch synchronisation
run.reuse: Reuse the last station epoch when a new one is missing
run.maxAge: Maximum age of a reused epoch
run.provisional: Mark a result using reused data as provisional
run.example: Example: source epochs at :25/:26/:32 may contribute to the 09:30 output slot when the tolerance permits. Source timestamps are never changed.
run.catchUpHelp: A late-data recalculation UPSERTs the same output slot with the configuration historically valid at that slot.

output.title: Output publication
output.maxEpochToSlot: Maximum source epoch to output slot offset
output.stableHelp: Output variables are created once and belong to the processing. A configuration version never creates new variables; recalculation replaces the same variable and timestamp by UPSERT.
output.summary: {{targets}} published target(s) × {{components}} components (adjusted coordinates, deltas and 1σ values in E/N/H) + {{global}} processing-wide indicators = {{total}} stable variables

review.createHelp: Creation is atomic: processing, version 1, physical-point mappings and stable output variables. No partial object remains after failure.

overview.noActive: No active configuration: output slots and operational runs are unavailable. Open Edit processing, test the configuration in Adjustment, then choose Save and activate version. A draft processing intentionally publishes nothing.
overview.noAlignedSlot: Configuration {{version}} is active, but no observation cycle can currently be aligned to an output slot.
overview.simulationHelp: These actions simulate the BTM orchestration and UPSERT publication. The live STAR*NET 14 configuration test is available in Edit processing → Adjustment.
overview.runLatest: Simulate a manual BTM run on the latest slot
overview.catchUp: Recalculate this slot with late data

overview.noRunActive: No run yet — trigger one above.
overview.noRunInactive: No run exists yet. Activate a tested configuration version before the first execution.

versions.help: Versions used by runs remain immutable. To reuse or change one, open it in the editor. Adjustment contains the scientific preflight and STAR*NET test; Review controls activation and the validity date.

outputs.stableHelp: Output variables are created once and remain stable across configuration versions. Recalculation replaces the value of the same variable and timestamp by UPSERT.
outputs.globalHelp: Processing-wide adjustment quality, availability and publication indicators.
outputs.noGlobal: No global output variable is configured.
outputs.perTargetHelp: Variables are grouped by physical target, then by adjusted coordinates, displacement and uncertainty on E/N/H.
outputs.units: metres stored; millimetres also shown for displacement and uncertainty
outputs.noMatch: No target matches the current search.

adjusted.label: Adjusted coordinates

sigma.label: Coordinate uncertainty
sigma.description: A-posteriori 1σ component uncertainty for the adjusted point.

reprocess.help: By default, every output slot is recalculated with the configuration valid at that slot. Forcing one version over the complete window is possible but must be justified. Existing values are replaced, never duplicated.
reprocess.perSlot: Resolve the historically valid version per slot (recommended)

analysis.title: Analysis Lab
analysis.subtitle: {{name}} · inspect, explain and improve one adjustment without changing raw observations
analysis.temporary: Every trial is temporary. Saving creates a new dated draft configuration; it never rewrites a used version or the raw observations.

choose.title: 1. Choose the configuration and epoch
choose.description: Select the configuration rules and output epoch. The latest active configuration and latest available epoch are selected automatically.

network.title: 2. Check the network geometry
network.description: The map follows the selected calculation. Purple double halos identify one physical point observed through several BTM targets; displacement colours compare adjusted and approximate coordinates.
network.noSolution: There is no adjusted solution yet, so the approximate geometry remains visible. Missing control or disconnected stations can therefore be diagnosed without an empty screen.
network.thresholdHelp: Visual thresholds only; they do not change χ² or publication rules.

editor.title: 3. Investigate and run a trial
editor.description: Start with geometry, then inspect residuals. Change precision only when it represents the real instrument, target or observation quality.
editor.multiplierHelp: 1 = configured precision; >1 gives all observations less influence
editor.parametersHelp: Hz and Vz are angular observations. Coordinate-control weights are shown with control points; sight-specific weights are shown in the table below.
editor.observationsSection: Observation precision, exclusions and measured values
editor.nativeTitle: Run this exact trial with STAR*NET 14
editor.nativeDescription: The prepared observations, exclusions, weights, coordinates and project options are sent to the isolated Windows service.

observations.title: Observation precision and use
observations.description: A smaller sigma gives an observation more weight; a larger sigma gives it less. Exclusions and edited values affect this trial only.
observations.warning: First inspect missing geometry and large residuals. Inflating sigmas can make χ² pass without improving the observations; the analysis will flag that situation.
observations.footer: Hz and Vz precision is expressed in arcseconds. Sd precision combines a millimetre constant and ppm term according to the configured EDM model.

review.title: 4. Review the current adjustment
review.description: Choose a completed calculation. The map and the single point table switch together; selecting a previous trial also restores its parameters for a new trial.
review.pending: Parameters or point controls have changed since {{trial}}. Run a new adjustment to update every value before saving.

points.title: All points · {{trial}}
points.description: Control points and shared physical points are shown first. Approximate and adjusted coordinates, displacements, precision, ellipses and quality always belong to the selected calculation.
points.edit: Edit approximate coordinates for the next trial

save.title: 5. Save the satisfactory setup as a dated version
save.description: This creates one complete draft from the selected calculation. The original version, historical runs and raw observations remain immutable.
save.newInitials: {{count}} adjusted free-point coordinates → new approximate coordinates
save.freed: This setup frees {{count}} control point(s). The new draft preserves that datum change for explicit review before activation.
save.editedValues: Edited Hz/Vz/Sd values are diagnostic only and are never written back to raw data or the candidate. Save an exclusion or correct the upstream observation instead.
save.invalid: This calculation cannot be saved: obtain a converged, full-rank solution whose χ² is passed or legitimately not applicable.
save.pending: Editor changes have not been calculated. Run a new adjustment before creating the version.
save.action: Save calculated setup as draft version
save.basedOn: Based on {{trial}}; values become effective only after review and activation.
save.success: Created {{label}} as a draft valid from {{date}}. Review and activate it from Configuration versions.

history.title: 6. Recalculate a historical period
history.description: Preview the affected output slots first. Existing values are replaced for the same variable and timestamp; no duplicate output series is created.
history.recommendation: Recommended: use the configuration historically valid for each slot. Force one version only for an intentional investigation and document why.
history.validVersion: Use the version valid for each slot
history.success: {{count}} slot(s) recalculated. Open processing runs to inspect each result.

quality.noSolution: The selected epoch does not contain enough independent geometry or control. Fix missing stations or control points before changing weights.
quality.failed: Inspect the largest residuals and observation precision. Do not increase sigmas only to force the test to pass.
quality.noRedundancy: The geometry has no independent check. Coordinates can be inspected, but χ² cannot prove their quality.
quality.passed: Review displacements, ellipses and exclusions before promoting this trial to a dated configuration version.

networkView.help: Drag to move · wheel or controls to zoom · select a point to inspect coordinates and uncertainty.
networkView.mapAria: Network map with stations, points and error ellipses

networkView.oneRayWarning: This point is controlled by one ray only. Its geometry is weak even when the solver converges.
networkView.inspectorHelp: Select a point on the network to display its adjusted coordinates, component sigmas, confidence ellipse and observation count.

diagnostic.noPoint: No point matches the current filters.
diagnostic.residualSearch: Find an observation, station or target
diagnostic.noResidual: No residual matches the current filters.
diagnostic.residualHelp: All scalar residuals are retained. Distances and constraints are shown in millimetres; angles are shown in arcseconds. Groups are ordered by their most critical normalised residual.
